description: All core modules, selectors, signal models, and app components. Load this node when making changes to any module.
mlMode: CPU-ONLY mandatory (CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES='', TF_DETERMINISTIC_OPS=1). GPU code paths exist but disabled for reproducibility on Kalpana.

stage1Selectors.note: All implement BasePairSelector (selectors_base.py). Re-exported via selectors.py.

selectors.CombinedCriteriaSelector: Cointegration + Hurst exponent + half-life (WORST: Net SR -0.824 old universe)

ml.file: core/selectors_ml.py (39.7KB ~10k tokens — DO NOT LOAD unless modifying DL selectors)

selectors.MLSelector: XGBoost with engineered spread features. BUG-02 fixed (shift lookahead removed). Still nets negative OOS.
selectors.LSTMSelector: BiLSTM 32 units/direction, dropout 20%, input (60,6). BEST individual selector (Net SR +0.341 old universe).
selectors.TransformerSelector: embed_dim=32, 4 heads, 2 encoder blocks. BUG-01 fixed (Lambda->named layer). Net SR +0.023 old universe.
selectors.GNNSelector: 2-layer GCN, W1 6x32, W2 32x16. 8 temporal snapshots. Net SR -0.448 old universe.

ml.weightOverrides: MLSelector weight=0.0 in E7 (label mis-specification confirmed). CNN weight=0.0 always.

models.OUThreshold: Ornstein-Uhlenbeck process. BEST signal (Net SR +0.359 stat_only, old universe). Use ou_only in all experiments.
models.ZScoreThreshold: Entry |z|>2, exit |z|<0.5. Net SR -0.358 old universe.
models.KalmanHedge: State-space Kalman Filter dynamic hedge ratio. Net SR -0.094.
models.MLSignal: XGBoost/GBM classifier. WORST (Net SR -0.401 old universe). Weight=0 in ensemble.

rlSignal.status: Class guarded behind 'gym is not None'. BUG-07 and BUG-09 fixed. NOT runnable on Kalpana (gymnasium not installed).

coreModules.data.py: 9.3KB ~2,300 tokens. DataConfig, yfinance fetch, Parquet cache override. freq='1D' only.
coreModules.ensemble.py: 4.1KB ~1,000 tokens. Weighted score/signal combination for Stage 1 and Stage 2.
coreModules.backtest.py: 11.6KB ~2,900 tokens. IndianCosts (16.28 bps), BacktestConfig, _apply_min_hold, backtest_pairs vectorized. BUG-08 fixed.
coreModules.reports.py: 12.3KB ~3,000 tokens. ReportManager (Singleton), BenchmarkComparison. Saves to reports/<YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS>/
coreModules.predictions.py: 21.3KB ~5,500 tokens. DO NOT LOAD unless working on real-time prediction.

experiments.config.py: 6.7KB ~1,700 tokens. NSE_TICKERS (89), DEFAULT_MIN_HOLD=30, RANDOM_SEED=42, date range 2015-2024.
experiments.walk_forward.py: 28.8KB ~7,000 tokens. DO NOT LOAD unless modifying WFV logic.
experiments.ablation.py: 27.1KB ~6,500 tokens. DO NOT LOAD unless modifying ablation logic. SLURM scripts at experiments/slurm/
experiments.freq_comparison.py: Frequency comparison E1. Not yet rerun on 89-ticker universe.
experiments.hold_period_sweep.py: Hold period E2. Not rerun on 89-ticker universe (D17: min_hold=30 locked).
experiments.significance_tests.py: E6. Complete for stat_only. Pending stat_ml and full modes.

app.file: app.py (60.7KB ~15k tokens — DO NOT LOAD unless modifying Streamlit UI)

slurmScripts.archived: Implementation/jobs/ — OLD scripts (wrong partition, GPU requests). DO NOT USE.
